author: Corridor Crew
description: Joe Letteri, senior VFX supervisor at Weta FX, joins us to explain how far they've pushed their process to achieve as much realism as possible in the way the characters in Avatar are animated to match their actors' performances.
title: WETA FX that really get Under your SKIN
